name: Exp_SuperTrend
summary: This EA trades based on the SuperTrend indicator, which combines CCI and ATR to determine trend direction. It opens buy positions when the SuperTrend signals an uptrend and sell positions when it signals a downtrend, with configurable position closing on signal reversals. The EA supports multiple money management modes and includes fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于SuperTrend指标进行交易，该指标结合CCI和ATR来判断趋势方向。当SuperTrend发出上升趋势信号时开多仓，发出下降趋势信号时开空仓，并可在信号反转时平仓。EA支持多种资金管理模式，并包含固定的止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用SuperTrend指标作为核心策略，SuperTrend结合CCI（商品通道指数）和ATR（平均真实范围）来识别趋势方向。入场条件为：当SuperTrend指标的上轨信号线（buffer 2）在指定信号K线上有有效值时，开多仓并平空仓；当下轨信号线（buffer 3）有有效值时，开空仓并平多仓。出场条件包括两种方式：一是通过反向信号触发平仓（如上升趋势信号出现时平空仓），二是通过固定点数的止损和止盈。此外，EA还检查指标的主线（buffer 0和1）来确认平仓信号，增加了额外的出场过滤。仓位管理方面，EA支持五种模式：基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于可用保证金减亏损、基于余额减亏损，以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认为0.1。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。信号延迟通过SignalBar参数控制，默认为1即使用上一根完成的K线。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the SuperTrend indicator as its core strategy, which combines CCI (Commodity Channel Index) and ATR (Average True Range) to identify trend direction. Entry conditions are: when the SuperTrend upper signal line (buffer 2) has a valid value on the specified signal bar, it opens a buy position and closes any sell position; when the lower signal line (buffer 3) has a valid value, it opens a sell position and closes any buy position. Exit conditions include two methods: first, reverse signal triggers position closure (e.g., sell positions close when an uptrend signal appears), and second, fixed stop-loss and take-profit in points. Additionally, the EA checks the indicator's main lines (buffers 0 and 1) to confirm close signals, adding an extra exit filter. Position sizing supports five modes: based on free margin, balance, free margin minus loss, balance minus loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter with a default risk ratio of 0.1. The EA uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate trades. Signal delay is controlled by the SignalBar parameter, defaulting to 1 which uses the last completed bar.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制每笔交易的风险占比
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio controlling risk percentage per trade

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式，包括按可用保证金、余额、净保证金、净余额或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Position sizing mode: free margin, balance, net free margin, net balance, or fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing buy positions on signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing sell positions on signal

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description_en: CCI level threshold for signal filtering

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于信号判断的K线索引，1表示上一根完成的K线
parameters.description_en: Bar index for signal evaluation, 1 means last completed bar

pros: 趋势跟踪策略逻辑清晰，SuperTrend指标结合CCI和ATR能有效捕捉中期趋势
支持多种资金管理模式，灵活性高，可根据账户情况选择合适的仓位计算方式
使用IsNewBar机制避免同K线内重复开仓，信号仅在新K线时计算，减少过度交易
入场和平仓信号独立可控，可以单独启用或禁用多空方向的开仓和平仓
止损和止盈参数可配置，风险控制有基本保障
pros_en: Clear trend-following logic; SuperTrend combining CCI and ATR effectively captures medium-term trends
Multiple money management modes offer flexibility to choose appropriate position sizing based on account conditions
IsNewBar mechanism prevents duplicate trades within the same bar and signals are only calculated on new bars, reducing overtrading
Entry and exit signals are independently configurable, allowing separate enable/disable of buy/sell opening and closing
Configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters provide basic risk control
cons: 止损和止盈为固定点数，未根据ATR动态调整，在不同波动率环境下可能不适配
没有点差过滤机制，在高点差品种上可能产生不利的入场价格
指标句柄创建失败时仅打印日志，缺少更完善的错误恢复机制
策略注释为乱码（编码问题），严重影响代码可读性和维护性
没有回撤控制或最大持仓限制，在极端行情下风险敞口可能过大
cons_en: Fixed stop-loss and take-profit in points rather than ATR-based, which may not adapt well across different volatility environments
No spread filter mechanism, potentially leading to unfavorable entry prices on high-spread instruments
Indicator handle creation failure only prints a log without robust error recovery
Code comments are garbled due to encoding issues, severely hurting readability and maintainability
No drawdown control or maximum position limit, risk exposure could become excessive during extreme market conditions
improvements: 将固定止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态止损止盈，以适应不同市场波动率
增加点差过滤，当点差超过阈值时禁止开仓，避免不利滑点
增加回撤控制和最大同时持仓数限制，降低极端行情下的风险敞口
修复源文件编码问题，将乱码注释恢复为可读的中文或替换为英文注释
improvements_en: Replace fixed stop-loss/take-profit with ATR-based dynamic levels to adapt to varying market volatility
Add spread filtering to prohibit entries when spread exceeds a threshold, avoiding unfavorable slippage
Add drawdown control and maximum concurrent position limits to reduce risk exposure in extreme conditions
Fix source file encoding issues, restore garbled comments to readable Chinese or replace with English

risk_points: 固定止损止盈在低波动品种上可能过宽，在高波动品种上可能过窄
无点差过滤，高点差环境可能导致入场价格严重偏离预期
无最大回撤限制，连续亏损时可能大幅侵蚀账户资金
risk_points_en: Fixed SL/TP may be too wide on low-volatility instruments and too narrow on high-volatility ones
No spread filter means high-spread environments can cause entry prices to deviate significantly from expectations
No maximum drawdown limit means consecutive losses could severely erode account equity
